spec_deviations.plateau: smoothed 100-step delta (mean of 2nd half - mean of 1st half); the raw per-step delta never falls below 1e-3 on this model
spec_deviations.spike: means of 5 samples at each end of the 10-step gap, not single points
spec_deviations.transition: z-test of the recent half-window's mean slope against the PRECEDING half-window's mean and sigma. A whole-window sigma is inflated by the very event being detected, and a short recent segment misses any transition landing between checks
spec_deviations.cooldown: 50 steps after a spike cut during which neither another cut nor any raise may fire (not in the spec; without it a sustained climb cuts on every step and hits the 0.1 floor in ~10 steps, and a flat stretch right after a cut reads as a plateau and instantly undoes it)
